newsitem.title: NIGERIA: 25 burn to death in Nigerian road accident.
newsitem.headline: 25 burn to death in Nigerian road accident.

text.p: More than 25 travellers were burned to death when their buses collided and burst into flames, the News Agency of Nigeria reported on Wednesday.
It said the accident occurred on Tuesday in southeast Akwa Ibom state.
Road accidents are common in Nigeria. Last week 30 students died when their bus collided with an articulated lorry in northern Nigeria.
